name: Christopher Mitchell

summary.text: Christopher Mitchell is the American Constitution Party candidate for Colorado's 5th Congressional District.
He earned a bachelor's degree from New Mexico State University in 1994 and works as an electrical engineer, based in Colorado Springs since 1997.
A former Republican, he previously ran for this seat in 2024 and for Mayor of Colorado Springs in 2023.

experience.text: Electrical engineering contractor supporting aerospace-industry technology companies.
Candidate, U.S. House Colorado District 5 (2024, American Constitution Party) and Mayor of Colorado Springs (2023); has never held elected office.

positions.quote: Legalizing the termination of innocent life of the born or unborn, whether by abortion, infanticide, euthanasia, or suicide, is a direct violation of their unalienable right to life.
positions.note: Listed as one of his three key campaign messages, 'Sanctity of Life.'
